subject: Deck ownership matrix & release sprint for investor update
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-15T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Deck ownership matrix & release sprint for investor update

Team —

We need a tight ownership matrix to get the investor update deck to a final, approvals-ready state. Key constraints:
- Freeze slides for editorial changes on 2026-08-22 (EOD PT).
- Final sign-offs and any legal redlines by 2026-08-24 (midday) so we can circulate the board packet on 8/25.

Proposed owners (please confirm or reassign):
- Company narrative / highlights: Monica (I'll do draft + one-pass)
- Growth & GTM metrics: Marissa (data-backed slides + derivations)
- Ops reliability / infra SLOs: Karthik
- Risk / governance / privacy: Neha (coordinate with legal)
- Financial snapshot: Jonas (work with FP&A for the two-pager)
- Appendix data tables: Marissa + Jonas (collate)

Attachments: deck_v5_draft.pptx (current working file), appendix_data_v2.xlsx (extracts), runbook_checklist.md (required approvals flow).

Asks: please reply with your ownership OK by EOD today and add any blockers in the doc in the Drive link below. We'll run two 45-min reviews next week: editorial pass (8/18) and stakeholder pass (8/20).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cD_example_deck_folder

If anyone needs legal pulled in directly, tag legal@vendor-legal.com — Neha, can you follow up with them for the privacy language?

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Head of Investor & Executive Communications
Redwood Inference

- Please move the "Data retention" bullet into the appendix and flag the retention table for legal to confirm.
- I want to add a one-slide summary of our SOC roadmap progress (status + ETA) — will need a short blurb from Security.

Legal: I've CC'd vendor-legal with a note to review the privacy blurb in appendix_data_v2.xlsx and the proposed retention language. Legal, can you confirm availability for a quick 20-min sync on 8/18?

Confirming ownership (OK): Neha (risk), will follow up with Security and Legal.

Monica —

Thanks for the outline. A few items from FP&A perspective:
- I'll produce a two-slide financial snapshot (P&L bridge + cash runway) and will need the final July actuals by 8/19 morning.
- Suggest we create a 1-page board summary (one-pager) that pulls the headline ask and key risks — that will help investor reviewers. If we want to be conservative, freeze narrative on 8/21 and only allow data updates until the 8/22 freeze.

Proposed timeline tweak:
- 8/18: editorial pass (monica + marissa + neha)
- 8/19: FP&A finalize figures (jonas)
- 8/20: stakeholder pass (wider leadership)
- 8/21: legal redline resolution
- 8/22 EOD: editorial freeze
- 8/24 midday: final sign-offs and circulation

Confirming I'll own finance slide deck content and the one-pager. I'll coordinate with FP&A and post the final two slides to the Drive when ready.

Jonas Weber
Head of Finance

Date: 2026-08-24T17:30:00-07:00
Subject: Final pass and sign-off request — investor packet (8/25 circulation)

Team —

Great work this sprint. I've consolidated edits from editorial and FP&A and built a final pass: deck_final_v6.pptx (attached to Drive). Key notes:
- Legal provided a retention confirmation and updated language in the appendix (Neha, thanks).
- FP&A final numbers incorporated (Jonas — verified).
- Growth slides updated with the cohort footnote (Marissa).

Asks:
1) Please review the attached final deck in Drive and confirm sign-off by 2026-08-24 19:30 PT. If you have a blocking redline, mark it in the doc comments and ping me directly.
2) I will route the deck for signatures via DocuSign at 20:00 PT. If you must be excluded from DocuSign (sensitive redline), reply-all now so we can carve an internal signature flow.

Attachments now in Drive: deck_final_v6.pptx, appendix_data_final.xlsx, runbook_checklist_final.md
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/EXAMPLE_LINK_FOR_BOARD
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cD_example_deck_folder

Thanks for the quick turnaround — we should be good to circulate to Ridge Ventures and the wider board list tomorrow morning. Ashley (cc'd) — we'll share the deck there at ~9am PT.

Monica Patel
Head of Investor & Executive Communications
Redwood Inference
